text: This report recommends that the name "Giacomini Way" be approved to identify an existing public lane located west of Salem Avenue, south of Shanly Street. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Giacomini Way" for an existing public lane located west of Salem Avenue, south of Shanly Street.
